title: Manhunt arrives on PlayStation 2

blocks.text: In 2003, Manhunt became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the horror category, Manhunt broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
